csv_project_name: Comprehensive Plan for New York Museum
csv_scope_of_work: ESD seeks qualified vendor(s) to develop a Comprehensive Plan for the $150M revitalization of the New York State Museum, reimagining the institution as a modern, world-class civic and cultural asset that inspires, engages, and serves New Yorkers and visitors for decades to come. The Comprehensive Plan will be based on the Vision Study and Visitor Study conducted by the NYSM and ESD in 2026 and should align directly to the principles and goals developed therein. ESD anticipates that successful application may require a teaming approach to proposal development, with different skillsets and capabilities needed to fulfill the scope outlined below. Development of the plan must include engagement with the State Museum Visioning Task Force established by Governor Hochul and State Education Commissioner Betty Rosa to guide the revitalization project
csv_disciplines_requested: Housing & Urban Development, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
